# Warren Chanansingh

> Warren Chanansingh — Toronto digital strategist who turns marketing spend into measurable growth through nine capabilities in three pillars: plan and measure (digital strategy, content strategy, digital analytics), reach and engage (paid media, social media management, community building and engagement), and convert and scale (email marketing, marketing automation, training and development). 12 years · $10M+ USD in media managed across Meta, Google, social and programmatic. Tagline: Conversion is the point.

Warren sets digital strategy, plans content, runs paid and social media, builds community, automates follow-up, builds email programs, measures results and trains teams, reporting against the KPIs leadership already tracks. He worked agency-side in Trinidad and Tobago across every digital media client at Lonsdale Saatchi & Saatchi and IUGO Digital, and is completing a Master of Digital Media at Toronto Metropolitan University (December 2026), where he is an Academic Assistant for three courses. He works in-house or on engagement: he is open to senior in-house digital strategy roles in Toronto (next start January 2027) and takes on a small number of consulting engagements and workshops.

Specialties: digital strategy, content strategy, digital analytics, paid media, social media management, community building and engagement, email marketing, marketing automation, training and development, performance marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, social media ads, programmatic advertising, conversion optimization, digital media in Toronto.

## Capabilities and the KPIs he owns
- Digital strategy: One plan from business goal to channel, so every dollar has a job. KPIs: Revenue growth, Customer acquisition cost, Marketing ROI, Pipeline. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#strategy)
- Content strategy: The right message, in the right format, at every stage of the journey. KPIs: Engagement rate, View-through rate, Cost per engagement, Content-assisted conversions. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#content)
- Digital analytics: Numbers leadership can trust, and act on. KPIs: Share of sales tracked, Cost per result by channel, Time to insight, Forecast accuracy. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#analytics)
- Paid media: Ad spend that answers to a number. KPIs: Cost per lead, Return on ad spend, Conversion rate, Cost per acquisition. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#paid-media)
- Social media management: Channels that build the brand and feed the pipeline, every week. KPIs: Engagement rate, Follower growth, Share of voice, Social-sourced leads. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#social)
- Community building and engagement: An audience that talks back, shares and comes back. KPIs: Engagement rate, Community growth, Response time, Shares and advocacy. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#community)
- Email marketing: Revenue from the audience you already own. KPIs: Revenue per subscriber, Click rate, List growth, Repeat purchase rate. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#email)
- Marketing automation: Every lead followed up and nurtured, without adding headcount. KPIs: Lead-to-customer rate, Speed to lead, Cost per acquisition, Hours saved. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#automation)
- Training and development: Teams that can plan, run and read their own campaigns. KPIs: Time to competency, Work done in-house, Tool adoption, Cost of outside support. (https://zabocaman.github.io/services.html#training)

## Quick answers
- What does Warren Chanansingh do? Warren Chanansingh is a Toronto digital strategist. He helps companies turn marketing spend into measurable growth through digital strategy, content strategy, digital analytics, paid media, social media management, community building and engagement, email marketing, marketing automation, and training and development. He has 12 years of experience and has managed more than $10M USD in media.
- How can I work with Warren Chanansingh? Two ways: in-house, owning digital strategy and results inside your team, or on engagement, for a growth audit, a 90-day growth plan or a team workshop scoped to one goal.
- Is Warren open to in-house roles? Yes. He is open to senior digital strategy roles in Toronto, covering any mix of digital strategy, content, social media, community, paid media, email, marketing automation, analytics, and training and development. His next in-house start is January 2027, after he completes his Master of Digital Media at Toronto Metropolitan University.
- What results has Warren delivered? His twelve published case studies include 614 leads against a target of 500 for an insurance provider in Jamaica, 1,779 leads for a vehicle dealership, 485,369 participations in an energy drink contest, and a tracked 57% of T20 cricket ticket sales through the online ticket page. Over 12 years he has managed more than $10M USD in media.
- Which KPIs would Warren report to leadership? The ones the business already runs on: revenue, customer acquisition cost, marketing ROI and pipeline, supported by channel measures such as cost per lead, return on ad spend, click rate and list growth.

## Case studies
- [Insurance Provider: Family plan leads](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/insurance-family-plan-leads.html): 614 leads against a target of 500, and the cost per lead fell as it ran.
- [Insurance Provider: Annuity leads](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/insurance-annuity-leads.html): 1,561 Meta leads and 81,773 Google clicks across two markets.
- [Vehicle Dealership: Sales events and lead campaigns](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/vehicle-dealership-sales-events.html): 1,779 leads and 1,217 event responses from six dealership sales pushes.
- [Professional Sports: T20 match tickets](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/sports-t20-tickets.html): A tracked 57% of ticket sales came through the online ticket page.
- [Professional Sports: Home international matches, 2025](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/sports-home-internationals-2025.html): 201,400 link clicks across six host markets, each with its own campaign.
- [Energy Drink Brand: Bottle-cap code contest, 2.0 and 3.0](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/energy-drink-cap-contest.html): Contest 2.0 drew almost four times the participations of 3.0.
- [Commercial Bank: Christmas loans, 2024](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/bank-christmas-loans.html): 27.7M impressions and 290K clicks for the bank's Christmas loans.
- [Money Transfer Company: Mobile app and remittances](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/money-transfer-app.html): 64,270 link clicks, and a click-through rate that more than doubled across 2025.
- [Energy Drink Brand: Product launch](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/energy-drink-product-launch.html): 4.38M ThruPlays across 12 territories for a product launch.
- [Confectionery Brand: Always-on social and promotions](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/confectionery-always-on.html): 3.2M post engagements from 90 campaigns in four markets.
- [Spirits Brand: Always-on social and Carnival](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/spirits-always-on.html): 29.0M impressions from 40 campaigns, and the brand in the feed 26 of 27 months.
- [Malt Beverage Brand: Augmented reality game](https://zabocaman.github.io/case-studies/malt-beverage-ar-game.html): The brand's first AR game, promoted on five channels: Google led on clicks.
